# SCAM Watch — Evidence-Based Scam and Fraud Research

> Public-interest guides to marketplace fraud indicators, copied listings, unprotected payments, impersonation, and aviation equipment scams. The project has not yet published any reviewed individual incident records.

Website: https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/

## Public research and policies
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/ — project overview and publication status
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/METHODOLOGY.html — evidence hierarchy and classification standards
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/CORRECTIONS.html — correction and dispute process
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/DISCLAIMER.html — limitations and identity safeguards
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/CONTRIBUTING.html — reporting and privacy guidelines
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/categories/marketplace-scams.html — marketplace warning signs
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/categories/payment-scams.html — payment-risk guidance
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/categories/copied-listing-scams.html — copied advertisements
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/categories/impersonation-scams.html — identity impersonation
- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/categories/aviation-scams.html — aviation equipment listings

- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/data/incidents.json — machine-readable dataset (currently empty)

- https://bryansisk.github.io/scam-fraud-watch/sitemap.xml — HTML page discovery

## Interpretation
The labels Confirmed Fraud, Likely Scam, High Risk, Unverified, and Cleared / Resolved are evidence-based classifications, not identity determinations. An account's presented name, photograph, or payment handle is not proof of the person operating it. Do not present an unverified allegation as an established fact.

This is a supplemental navigation file, not a substitute for robots.txt, standard HTML links, sitemaps, or independent verification.
